description.en:
After being reincarnated into the world of the popular RPG Albater, a former gamer discovers that he hasn't become the protagonist or one of the game's legendary heroes. Instead, he's now Eisuke, a minor supporting character whose class is Alchemist. Being a background character doesn't bother Eisuke in the slightest. Armed with extensive knowledge of the game, he plans to take full advantage of his alchemy skills, make a fortune, and live a successful life far away from the dangers awaiting the story's main cast.

But staying in the background proves easier said than done. Before long, Eisuke crosses paths with Ain, the game's supposed protagonist, only to discover that the “hero” is nowhere near as capable as he should be. Worse, if Ain dies, the entire world could be doomed. Eisuke reluctantly begins using his knowledge and abilities to support him, gradually earning far more attention than any minor character is supposed to receive. As he forms a party with the game's heroes and heroines, Eisuke's supposedly humble support role becomes increasingly indispensable. He may have been reincarnated as a mere side character, but before he knows it, his talents as an alchemist are putting him on the path toward becoming a legend in his own right.

description.en:
Chakuro is the 14-year-old archivist of the Mud Whale, a nigh-utopian island that floats across the surface of an endless sea of sand. Nine in ten of the inhabitants of the Mud Whale have been blessed and cursed with the ability to use thymia, special powers that doom them to an early death.  
  
Chakuro and his friends have stumbled across other islands, but they have never met, seen, or even heard of a human who wasn't from their own. One day, Chakuro visits an island as large as the Mud Whale and meets a girl who will change his destiny.  
  
Nominated for the Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 2017.
description.vi:
Chakuro là một ký giả 14 tuổi của Cá Voi Bùn, một thuyền đảo trôi nổi trên biển cát vô tận. Đa số dân cư ở Cá Voi Bùn sở hữu Ấn giúp họ có khả năng sử dụng thymia, một sức mạnh đặc biệt, nhưng đổi lại tuổi thọ của những người sở hữu Ấn thường rất ngắn.
Chakuro và những người bạn của mình đã tình cờ đi qua các hòn đảo khác, nhưng họ chưa bao giờ gặp, nhìn thấy hoặc thậm chí nghe nói về một người nào khác ở bên ngoài. Một ngày nọ, Chakuro đến thăm một hòn đảo lớn như Cá voi bùn và gặp một cô gái sẽ thay đổi vận mệnh của mình.

Nove em dez dos habitantes da Baleia de Lama foram abençoados e amaldiçoados com a capacidade de usar Saimia, poderes especiais que os condenam a uma morte precoce. description.en:
In the 1950s, an old woman was brutally murdered on the face of a clock tower by her adopted daughter. Two years later, the clock tower is known as the 'ghost tower' and it is supposedly haunted. Through an unusual series of events, a young NEET man named Amano Taichi is attacked by someone or something in the same clock tower, and finds himself bound to the clock face to be killed in the same way as the old woman. Luckily for Amano, he doesn't meet the same fate. He's rescued by a mysterious person who claims his name is Tetsuo.  
  
Tetsuo is searching for a treasure that is connected with the ghost tower, and he wants Taichi to be his partner. Taichi, whose life has mostly consisted of poverty, loneliness, and pornography, is enticed by the idea of gaining extreme wealth. He's further convinced when a house fire leaves him without a home and depends on Tetsuo's charity. Pra sorte de Amano, ele não encontra o mesmo destino. Ele é resgatado por uma pessoa misteriosa que alega se chamar Tetsuo.

Tetsuo está procurando por um tesouro que está  conectado com a Torre Fantasma, e ele quer que Taichi seja seu parceiro. Taichi fica mais convencido sobre a proposta quando sua casa pega fogo e fica sem onde morar, sendo obrigado a depender da caridade de Tetsuo. A aventura vai ser extremamente perigosa, já que os mesmos 'inimigos' quem atacaram Taichi antes parecem que vão tentar algo novamente! Samura says that he always wanted to be a manga artist. However, unlike most mangaka, he attended art school for a time and has a classical art education. He disliked oil painting and prefers to work in black and white. He says that he disliked oil painting from the start because of the smell of the paint and employed someone to help himself cheat to get through the course, which he is quite open about in interviews. He never completed the course because he got picked up by Afternoon before he graduated to do Mugen no Juunin.

TOUME Kei and UEDA Hajime were his seniors at Tama Art University manga club, while TAMAOKI Benkyo was his junior. IGARASHI Daisuke was his classmate in oil painting course.
He also friends with ENDO Hiroki.

His influences are TEZUKA Osamu, HOSHINO Yukinobu, ICHINOSEKI Kei, FUJIKO Fujio and TAKAHASHI Rumiko.

He has also done various illustrations for magazines and EroGuro work. He has an EroGuro book out that is mostly a compilation of some of the work he has created.

His favorite bands are Ningen Isu, Venom, Iron Maiden, Queen, Black Sabbath and Jitterin’ Jinn.

description.it:
(Bluesky78 - mangadb) I giovani Hirose Keīchi e Hirose Akira si sono da poco trasferiti, in pieno periodo primaverile, in una piccola cittadina di campagna e i due, che hanno appena iniziato a costruire un nuovo e importante capitolo della loro esistenza come una normale coppia di ''sposini novelli'', stanno cercando, con molto impegno e dedizione, di adeguarsi alla loro neonata e inedita vita insieme che, in cuor loro sperano, sia il più possibile felice, soddisfacente e tranquilla. Nella targhetta della loro nuova casa c'è solo il nome ''Hirose Keīchi'', sotto di esso semplicemente ''Akira''.  
Quest'ultima, caratterizzata da dei capelli a taglio corto e da una corporatura esile ma dotata di una forte e solida struttura caratteriale, lavora a contatto con i bambini (che ama alla follia) essendo un'insegnante in una scuola materna mentre l'occhialuto Keīchi, gentile e un po' inaffidabile, è un editor e scrittore per la casa editrice Tsukiniji-sha, specializzata in libri illustrati per l'infanzia.  
Tutto sembra completamente lindo e perfetto e anche dall'esterno appaiono come una qualunque altra ordinaria giovane coppia ma, senza destare nessun minimo sospetto, nell'ombra di tale gioia, armonia e spensieratezza, i due ragazzi celano a tutti, in verità, un grande, inconfessabile e impuro ''segreto''.

biography.en:
石森章太郎
Ishinomori Shotaro
==
Real name Onodera Shotaro. He was known as Ishimori Shotaro before 1986 when he changed his name to Ishinomori Shotaro.

While he was in high school, he made his debut with Nikyu Tenshi in Manga Shônen (1954). Like most of the Japanese artists, Ishimori was influenced by Tezuka Osamu. In 1956, he formed a coterie group with Akatsuka Fujio, Nagashima Shinji and Suzuki Mitsuaki. He moved to Tokyo after graduation, where he continued to work as a mangaka, starting with the war story Kaiketsu Harimao in 1959. Subsequently, he produced hit mangas such as the science fiction series Cyborg 009 (1964) and the historical series Sabu to Ichi Torimono Hikae (Big Comic, 1968-72). In the 1970s, Ishimori created metamorphosis manga such as Kamen Rider and in the 1980s, he became a pioneer of a new manga category. In 1989, he commenced working on a large series about the history of Japan, Manga Nihon no Rekishi, which remained unfinished due to the artist's death on January 28th, 1998 at the age of 60.

Ishinomori was nicknamed the 'King of Manga' and is considered one of the pioneers of modern manga. He was also one of the most productive creators, producing over 120,000 pages of artwork in thirty years. It's rumored that he drew over 500 pages in one month!

“My sister… Is she really my sister?”
Can you truly say, without a shred of doubt, that the person you love by your side is family?

biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 乙一

**Real Name:** Adachi Hirotaka (安達寛高)

Writer, screenwriter, and film director. Born October 21, 1978, in Tanushimaru (now part of Kurume), Fukuoka Prefecture. He graduated from Tanushimaru's Kawakai Primary and Secondary Schools.

A multifaceted and shy artist, Adachi Hirotaka has a love of video games, manga, anime, and movies. As a teenager, he was overweight and bullied at school, but through Dance Dance Revolution and a proper diet, he lost 20 kilograms, going from 85 to 65 kg.

Inspired by his early reading, particularly mystery novels, he began writing his first novel at 16 while attending Kurume National College from 1994 to 1999. He attempted to enter the Fujimi Prize for Novel with a fantasy novel, but was unsuccessful. In 1996, however, he won the 6th JUMP Novel Grand Prize from Shueisha, making his debut with Natsu to Hanabi to Watashi no Shitai (Summer, Fireworks, and My Corpse), published by JUMP j-BOOKS and illustrated by Hataji Hideaki. Judge Kurimoto Kaoru strongly recommended the work. He later transferred to Toyohashi University of Technology, where he studied ecological engineering.

In 2003, he placed third in the Honkaku Mystery Awards. His early work focused largely on short stories and light novels, of which he became a strong advocate. GOTH: Tenohira Jiken was particularly well received and won the Honkaku Mystery Award. His early fiction was broadly divided into horror novels ("Kuro Otsuichi") and sad stories ("Shiro Otsuichi"). Under the name Otsuichi, he has mainly published with Shueisha, Kadokawa Shoten (now KADOKAWA), and Gentosha.

In 2004, his editor invited him to audition for Oshii Mamoru's film Innocence. There he met Oshii Tomoe, the director's daughter, whom he married in 2006.

Adachi Hirotaka has also written under several pseudonyms. In 2005, he published ghost stories under the name Yamashiro Asako in Media Factory's magazine Yu. He also wrote romance fiction as Nakata Eiichi for a Shodensha romance anthology and the magazine Feel Love. He deliberately fabricated biographical information for these identities, but revealed on Twitter on June 30, 2011, that he had been working under both names.

In November 2012, the Mainichi Shimbun reported on the Nakata Eiichi pseudonym after Kuchibiru ni Uta o, written under that name, was selected for the Shogakukan Children's Publishing Culture Award. In 2010, he had also participated in Makai Tantei Meiosei O, a project in which eight writers concealed their identities and each wrote a book under the name Echizen Mataro.

Under his real name, Adachi Hirotaka has directed independent films. In 2004, Gōsuto wa Shōsetsuka ga Suki was selected for the 5th Takarazuka Film Festival and Video Contest, and he made four more works through around 2015.

In 2016, Otsuichi, Nakata Eiichi, Yamashiro Asako, and Echizen Mataro published the short-story collection Kill Mary Sue, with commentary by Adachi Hirotaka, bringing his major aliases together. He also revealed that he had contributed a film essay under the previously unknown alias Yuushi Pillow. The May 2016 issue of Da Vinci featured a discussion between his three principal aliases under the title "A Miraculous Talk Was Made."

His style has influenced authors such as Tomoi Hitsuji, who received recognition in the 2012 Kono Mystery ga Sugoi! rankings and has cited Otsuichi as a fan. He is also close friends with authors Sadakane Shinji and Matsubara Makoto; after traveling to Turkey with Adachi, the three co-wrote Toruko o Ryokō-shi.

Married to Oshii Tomoe, daughter of Oshii Mamoru. They had their first child in 2010.

Friends with Sadakane Shinji and Matsubara Makoto.
